evidence_class: bounded exploratory geometry sensitivity; not qualification
question: Does the angular placement of the 20 selected H1 midside nodes measurably affect the archived static torsion observables when topology, source, loads, supports, and every other coordinate are held fixed?

variants.definition: Unmodified archived H1 mesh and setup; re-solve once under the new source/scope as an execution control.

From A, move only the 20 selected unique midside nodes to the short-arc angular midpoint on radius 0.5 m; preserve each node's stored x coordinate, topology, all other coordinates, material, setup, loads, supports, and solver source. Preflight must stop if selected midside IDs are not unique or if any resulting TET10 validity check fails.

predeclared_observables: Tip twist angle and its descriptive difference from the same Saint-Venant reference.
Applied and reaction torque, free residual, strain energy, and archived contract criteria, reported separately for each variant.
Integration-point shear error against Saint-Venant using the same element/IP labels and weights; interpret paired values as a geometry sensitivity, not pointwise identical physical positions.

decision_policy.status: No new PASS tolerance is defined for the sensitivity itself. Report paired deltas and any existing J24B checks without changing thresholds or J24B verdicts.
decision_policy.inconclusive: Any missing observable, non-unique projection target, invalid mesh, failed solver, or incomplete trace makes the comparison INCONCLUSIVE; do not replace the archived H1 result.

execution_plan.estimated_elapsed_basis: J24B R1 completed all four levels in 75.07 s; H1's archived level was 6.20 s. This estimate covers two H1 calls plus pre/post-processing and is not a measurement.
execution_plan.budget_semantics: Timeout, RSS, process and storage are monitored soft limits; captured output caps are enforced by the registered launcher.

required_artifacts: Frozen source SHA, contract/input hashes, and generated variant mesh hash.
Preflight mesh-quality and geometry report before either solve.
Per-variant checkpoints for reactions, residual, energy, twist, integration-point stresses, runtime and resources.
stdout/stderr, launcher ledger, environment/dependency versions, comparison JSON/CSV and figures.

execution_scope_required.required_action: Register a new exact nodeid, worktree/source inventory, owner scope, preflight, attempt ledger, and budget before execution. The single J24B contract-002 attempt is consumed.
execution_scope_required.authorization_status: J24D authorizes archive analysis and contract preparation only; this proposal is not an execution authorization.
